messages.subject: Changing the title itemGAM plots?
parts:
Hi, 

I am sure this a newb issue but I would love any input since I am stumped. I would like to change the "main" argument in the plot method for itemGAM, but lattice throws an error because "formal argument "main" matched by multiple actual arguments." I am not sure how to override the "main" argument passed to trellis via the plot method, because I have almost no idea how lattice works. Any help would be great!

Also, as a suggestion, it would be nice if passing "main" and other plotting args to the plot function did not result in an error. 

Thanks! Peter

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: Changing the title itemGAM plots?
parts:
The plots are created using the lattice package, so it's always possible to store the plotting objects before printing them and edit the components that you need in the object (there's examples of this approach in this forum). Otherwise, using something like the latticeExtra (e.g., using + layer(...)) or gridExtra package would allow for these models to be edited quickly in a way similar to how ggplot2 works. 

Phil
